messages.content: 公司XYZ明年的損失預測是多少？

function.name: finance_predict_revenue
function.description: Predict the revenue of a company for a specific period based on historical data and industry trends. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

period.description: The period for which revenue is to be predicted, e.g. next year.

industry_trends.description: Whether to consider industry trends in prediction. Defaults to false.

message.content: 我目前只能根據歷史營收資料和行業趨勢來預測公司 XYZ 的未來營收。若要估算「損失」（即營收減去成本/費用後的淨損），還需要公司的成本、費用、稅率等相關財務資訊。請問您是否有這些成本或費用的數據，或者想先得到營收預測再進一步討論損失估算？
message.reasoning: The user asks: "公司XYZ明年的損失預測是多少？" They want the loss forecast for company XYZ next year. We have a function to predict revenue, but not loss. We could use revenue prediction and maybe assume some cost? But we don't have cost data. The function only predicts revenue. We could call the function to get revenue, but the question is about loss. We might respond that we cannot predict loss without cost data. Or we could ask for more info. According to policy, we should not fabricate. So we should ask for more details or explain limitation. We can also mention that we can predict revenue but not loss. So we should ask for cost data or clarify.
